svg.title: VA35 anchor fits extended toward full compression
svg.desc: Pressure in kilopascals versus compression, with the horizontal axis extending to 100 percent. Both fits diverge at 100 percent in the EVA equation. Curves are clipped, not flattened, at 1500 kilopascals, near 93.3 percent for one anchor and 93.7 percent for two anchors. Shading beyond 80 percent marks extrapolation beyond the study range. The supplier points are at 25 and 50 percent. At 50 percent the one-anchor curve gives 122.6 kilopascals and the two-anchor curve matches 118. This is continuation of the slow EVA equation, not the separate density-based extension or measured high-compression VA35 data.
